2 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for respondent No.1.
Sri Shivakumar Maliptail, learned counsel accepts notice for respondent No.2.

2. In this petition, the petitioners seek the following relief:
"i) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus, directing the respondent No.2 to make reference by complying the order passed by Ist Additional District Judge, Kalaburagi in Misc. No.38 of 2019 as per Annexure-F."

3. The limited grievance of the petitioners in the present petition is, despite the order dated 20th September 2021 passed in Miscellaneous (LAC) No.38/2019 by the NC: 2024:KHC-K:8295 I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi, allowing the petition filed by the petitioners under Section 64 (1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Karnataka Housing Board has not taken any steps to comply with and give effect to the said order and as such, the petitioners are before this Court by way of the present petition.
4.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for respondent No.2 submits that if reasonable time is granted, the 2nd respondent-SLAO would take necessary steps to comply with and give effect to the order dated 20th September 2021 passed in Miscellaneous (LAC) No.38/2019.
His submission is placed on record.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the petition stands disposed of, directing the 2nd respondent to take necessary steps to comply with and give effect to the order dated 20th September 2021 passed in Miscellaneous (LAC) No.38/2019 in accordance NC: 2024:KHC-K:8295 with law within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

Sd/-
